💷 John Healey is Chancellor, and an autumn Budget is coming.

The tax burden is already at a post-war high. Thresholds are frozen — a stealth tax that drags nurses, tradespeople and pensioners into higher bands every year while ministers claim they haven't raised a thing. Debt is near the size of the entire economy.

Reform UK would lift the threshold so the lowest earners pay no income tax, unfreeze the bands, and fund it by cutting waste — not by reaching deeper into your pocket.
